name: Consumption statement submission line
description: Submitted consumption statement amount assigned to an accounting account and an apportionment.

condo_id.label: Condominium
condo_id.help: Select the condominium that owns the statement, account and apportionment.

consumption_statement_id.label: Consumption statement
consumption_statement_id.description: Consumption statement the submission relates to.
consumption_statement_id.help: Only statements from the selected condominium are available.

consumption_file_section_id.label: Source section
consumption_file_section_id.description: Consumption file section from which the submission was generated.
consumption_file_section_id.help: Identifies the source section for the submitted amount.

account_id.label: Accounting account
account_id.description: Accounting account the submitted amount relates to.
account_id.help: Only accounts from the selected condominium are available.

apportionment_id.label: Apportionment
apportionment_id.description: Apportionment used to distribute the submitted amount.
apportionment_id.help: Only apportionments from the selected condominium are available.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Submitted amount assigned to the accounting account and apportionment.
amount.help: Enter the amount declared for this account and apportionment.

form.default.name: Consumption statement submission line
form.default.description: Edit a submitted amount of a consumption statement.

list.default.name: Consumption statement submission lines
list.default.description: Submitted consumption statement amounts by accounting account and apportionment.

errors.statement_submissions_locked: Submissions can only be edited while the statement is in draft or proforma.
